# Quick Ride

> A Kenyan marketplace for buying, renting, and financing vehicles.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Quick Ride car marketplace.
- [Buy cars](/inventory): Vehicles for sale.
- [Rent cars](/rentals): Car hire listings with daily rates and locations.
- [Compare](/compare): Compare vehicles.
- [Reviews](/reviews): Expert vehicle reviews.
- [Finance calculator](/finance/calculator): Estimate vehicle financing.
